limits.value: product and category pages both 404 on 2026-10-23

identity_cost.detail: store checkout in Dehradun, India; card, netbanking, wallets or UPI

reliability_note: An Indian 'official reseller' page that indexed at ₹900 for 30 days and ₹3,800 for 360 days, then disappeared. The disappearance is the finding.

the category page also 404s; the store's own payment rails (card, netbanking, wallets, UPI) are still printed in the footer

notes: Kept because a dead reseller is a finding: the ₹900 price point that search still surfaces cannot be bought. Do not cite it as a live Indian price without re-checking the store.
